# AO-001 authorization and realization multiplicity amendment — r0.6

Status: frozen normative micro-repair

The package may authorize more than one separately named AO-001 method. The
recommended architecture authorizes both `AO-001-A` and `AO-001-C` while
retaining B and D as successor-authorship triggers.

Authorization and selection remain distinct:

1. package-level method authorization;
2. per-parent-class authorization, with observation and coadd separate;
3. per-named-use authorization;
4. one exact method requested for each realization;
5. engineering representation only after scientific meaning is fixed; and
6. typed unavailable or successor-trigger routes.

One realization never mixes methods, selects from target data, or falls back
between A and C. A alone may carry `established_exact_local_GLS` and
`v_GLS,reference=d_p^-1`; C is nonoptimal and implies no noise, covariance,
stationarity, isotropy, or reference-variance claim.
